A regression here could publish a stale alert for an already finished collaboration.

testing|entry/src/main/ets/pages/Notific.why_it_matters: When an owner revokes family access after the detail GET and before the read POST, the screen must withhold the cached message body. The new two-request gate is the privacy boundary in this page, yet the frontend test suites only contain template string assertions. A regression that assigns the GET result before checking the read response would expose revoked content on screen.

julik-frontend-races|entry/src/main/ets/.why_it_matters: After tapping 全部已读, a user can return to 我的 and reopen the inbox before the POST finishes. The new list request may read the old unread state; when the POST later succeeds, its callback is discarded by the generation check, so the inbox keeps showing unread messages and count until another refresh. The same sequence after acknowledging or closing a family event can leave its old action button visible. Keep mutation completion separate from render cancellation and refresh the current page when an older mutation settles.
